name: Makina DUSD manipulable Curve accounting instruction
summary: Makina approved a permissionless accounting instruction that valued the Caliber's Curve MIM/3CRV position with the pool's manipulable calc_withdraw_one_coin quote. A searcher flash-manipulated that pool, ran the instruction to inflate Caliber and Machine AUM, and the inflated DUSD rate let two cycles drain the DUSD/USDC Curve pool's USDC.
notes: Reset is the Safe scheduling allowed-instruction root 0xbb37df0f… behind a 48-hour timelock; the root took effect without a further tx. The exploit's accountForPosition calldata reverts with the previous root (block 24220629) and passes before the exploit, so the instruction entered with this root.

Loss is the DUSD/USDC pool's USDC depletion in the anchor; its DUSD balance was unchanged. The Machine propagated the inflated AUM but carries no defect of its own; later trades against the drained pool and recoveries are not counted.
